A FEW THINGS YOU MIGHT BE WONDERING

Good questions.
Thoughtful answers.

These are the proposed shop policies.
This concept creates no redeemable cards.

How do digital gift cards work?

The proposed service would email a unique redemption code. This local version previews the message only: it sends nothing and creates no usable code.

Do gift cards expire?

“Never expires” is the proposed Lumina policy from the brief. The local sample balance has no expiration; no real store commitment is offered.

Can I combine a gift card with other offers?

The proposed policy allows other promotions. Redemption, coupon validation and real shopping are not connected in this static concept.

What if I lose my physical card?

A connected shop could verify an order with support. This concept has no order numbers, identity checks or replacement service.

Can I reload my gift card?

Reloading is not part of the proposed product. You can experiment with additional local gift-card configurations instead.

Are gift cards refundable?

Non-refundable but transferable is an example policy. There are no payments, purchased cards, refunds or actual transfer rights in this demo.
